source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: On October 29, 2026, there were 6,900,209,006 shares of Bank of America Corporation Common Stock outstanding.

notes: Common stock only, listed on the NYSE as BAC. Bank of America also has many series of preferred stock outstanding (some listed as depositary shares); they are fixed-claim securities with their own liquidation preferences, not common equity, and are left out, as the 'every class of equity' rule was read to mean classes of common equity.
